findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (54.81 yds from volume vs 54.61 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We OVER-project attempts by 1.41 per player (projected 29.38, actual 27.97).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.16 (projected 7.11, actual 7.27).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 79.56, without it 77.69. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 11/34 (32.35%). Our MAE 79.56 vs the line's 71.53. The book is the better projection.
